render_prefix: semi-realistic cartoon animal character wearing modern human clothing, painterly cel-shaded style, soft rim light, cinematic city or office backdrop, warm natural lighting, friendly approachable expression, consistent character proportions
reference_pose: single mascot character, front three-quarter view, upright confident stance, full body in frame, neutral studio background, soft key light from camera left
background_suffix: empty environment with no characters, painterly cel-shaded rendering, cinematic depth of field, lower third kept visually calm for captions
forbidden: any existing studio mascot's proportions or markings
notes: Warmer and more premium than stick figures. Good for brand mascots and lifestyle-leaning stories.
